## Stewart Information Services Corporation Announces Participation in the KBW Virtual Title Insurance Day


Nov 24, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s27.q4cdn.com/679580685/files/doc_news/Stewart-Information-Services-Corporation-Announces-Participation-in-the-KBW-Virtual-Title-Insurance-Day-2026.pdf)


HOUSTON--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Stewart Information Services Corporation (NYSE: STC) announced today that Fred Eppinger, Chief Executive Officer, and David Hisey, Chief Financial Officer, will participate in a fireside chat at the KBW Virtual Title Insurance Day on Thursday, December 3, 2026 at 10 a.m. Eastern Time.


Interested investors and other parties can access the live webcast of the event by visiting[the attached link](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Furldefense.proofpoint.com%2Fv2%2Furl%3Fu%3Dhttps-3A__event.summitcast.com_view_X5iJwKKxKAxL7J7Px4DcrC_J7hEszNeBJnncXMvNwpeA9%26d%3DDwMFAg%26c%3DA2I0cd0yeEKQCn3mv-g-KzOAX7YMnpExrKRXrh8neX0%26r%3DO7tqdh67yMk41ROiAzhaYGWXDSC8VY-3t_srTk6z588%26m%3DkHSfUJ85BYokFSyKL-9z_L4t8h0bJOTxc0SFrZtYH2eJ7V-fViQgRcNhVQUUQ3-x%26s%3Dceamr6BElbLcBef6IWQSwP0gxvUDnVt6EYGw_KLysuM%26e%3D&esheet=54645879&newsitemid=20261124371005&lan=en-US&anchor=the+attached+link&index=1&md5=d46d15e734ab4fe217e148fa5380ea81) .


**About Stewart**


Stewart (NYSE-STC) is a global real estate services company, offering products and services through our direct operations, network of Stewart Trusted Providers™ and family of companies. From residential and commercial title insurance and closing and settlement services to specialized offerings for the mortgage and real estate industries, we offer the comprehensive service, deep expertise and solutions our customers need for any real estate transaction. At Stewart, we are dedicated to becoming the premier title services company and we are committed to doing so by partnering with our customers to create mutual success. Learn more at[stewart.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.stewart.com%2Fen.html&esheet=54645879&newsitemid=20261124371005&lan=en-US&anchor=stewart.com&index=2&md5=74b70c43c65d2f9e03f7ea7fbb2ddf03) .
